concern_details.detail: main types of users that interact with the system
concern_details.why: Two concrete actors, Citizen and Municipal operator, both specialize a generic User. This matches the two roles offered at registration (UserRegistrationGUI.java:112-113) and the role-specific dashboards (UserDashboardGUI.java:317-346).

concern_details.detail: goals each of them can achieve through it
concern_details.why: Each actor is associated with the goals the code gives that role: shared register/log in, citizen create/review submitted, operator review received/update status/add note/monitor trends. These match SystemServicesController's service methods and the dashboard panel visibility.

concern_details.detail: how the functionalities are related to each other
concern_details.why: Three <<include>> relations show that both review use cases share the report details/history view and that a status update triggers a notification. The view leaves out that adding an internal note is only reached from the details of a received report. It also does not link the notification to the citizen who reads it.

level_why: Ten user-goal use cases and three actors give an overview of what the system offers. Logout, navigation, report fields and state-machine steps are left out, which suits an overview.

findings.claim: Add internal note is opened only from the details dialog of a received report, but the view shows no relation from it to Review received reports or View report details and history. It looks like an independent top-level goal.
findings.fix: Draw ucNote ..> ucDetails as <<extend>> (or extend Review received reports). Alternatively, keep the operator association and add that extend link.

findings.claim: The README assumes no screen lets citizens read notifications, but the citizen's report details dialog has a 'View Notifications' option. The citizen can therefore see these notifications, yet the diagram does not connect the citizen to the notification use case.
findings.fix: Rename ucDetails to 'View report details, history and notifications', or associate Citizen with ucNotify as the receiving actor. Then correct the README assumption.

findings.claim: Update report status can also be launched from the received-reports list, besides from its own dashboard panel. The view shows it only as a standalone goal.
findings.fix: Optionally add ucStatus extends Review received reports. Keeping the direct operator association is also acceptable at overview level.

findings.claim: The note says notification happens only for notifiable statuses, which makes the step conditional. A conditional step fits <<extend>> with a condition better than an unconditional <<include>>.
findings.fix: Draw ucNotify ..> ucStatus as <<extend>> with condition [new status is notifiable]. Alternatively, keep <<include>> and leave the note as it is.
